events.title: ICJ ruling on Myanmar genocide: ‘Historic victory for Rohingya, landmark for international justice’
events.description: Erin Ogunkeye welcomes Reed Brody, Member of the International Commission of Jurists, Human Rights Lawyer and veteran war crimes prosecutor. The International Court of Justice's ruling on Myanmar marks, according to Brody, "a historic victory for the Rohingya, but also a landmark for international justice." He explains how the court assessed evidence of genocidal intent, rejecting Myanmar's justification of its military operations as counterterrorism. He argues that "the existence of an armed conflict or a security objective doesn't exclude genocidal intent," a finding he believes will have "far-reaching implications in future genocide cases," including South Africa's case against Israel over Gaza. Brody also discusses the Gambia's role in bringing the case and growing challenges to international accountability, warning that "we're in a very dangerous moment."
events.ticker_label: 🪖 ICJ ruling on Myanmar genocide: ‘Historic victory for Rohingya, landmark for international justice’

events.title: Germany news: Pistorius visits Auschwitz memorial in Poland trip
events.description: Germany's defense minister's first stop in Poland was the memorial site of the former Nazi extermination camp Auschwitz-Birkenau. Follow DW for more.

events.title: European leaders present united front in push for peace in Ukraine
events.description: Talks in Berlin end with reaffirmed support for Kyiv and a concerted push for European representation at future peace talks to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 European leaders present united front in push for peace in Ukraine

events.title: Xi-Trump-Putin summit: What did it achieve?
events.description: The presidents of China, the US and Russia have held an unprecedented summit. While Trump said the three leaders were "making history," Xi described the talks as "fruitful," and Putin called them "open and candid."

events.title: Anthropic trading tests investors' appetite for AI
events.description: Anthropic was valued at $2 trillion after shares started trading on the Nasdaq following a record $81 billion IPO. Its performance will put investor confidence in AI to the test.

events.title: Pakistan minister to visit India, but no breakthrough expected
events.description: A Pakistani minister's visit to India for a Shanghai Cooperation Organization forum marks a rare high-level contact between the two archrivals, but analysts say it does not signal a resumption of bilateral engagement.

events.title: South Korea's top court overturns jail term for former PM Han
events.description: Former Prime Minister Han Duck-so was convicted of helping legitimize the 2024 martial law declaration. The case will now return to a lower court.

events.title: Iran balances ties with China and Russia as Trump ramps up pressure
events.description: As Donald Trump seeks to tighten economic pressure on Iran, China remains its biggest oil customer and Russia a key partner. But both powers are balancing support for Tehran against broader interests with Washington.

events.title: Is the AI bubble bursting just as Anthropic goes public?
events.description: The sharp sell-off in tech stocks after the US midterms and the Nvidia scandal has cast doubt on Anthropic's IPO. Yet with hundreds of billions still being invested, some think the AI party is still in full swing.

events.title: NASA's Voyager 1 phones home from record one light-day away, 49 years after launch
events.description: The Voyager 1 probe launched by NASA nearly a half century ago has reached a distance from Earth of one light day (more than 26 billion kilometres), the farthest any human artifact has ever ventured from our planet. The space agency received a signal from the spacecraft Thursday, exactly 24 hours after it was sent.

events.title: 🔴Anthropic soars more than 30% to $2 trillion valuation on first day of trading
events.description: No description available.

events.title: 'GTA VI': A masterpiece? Fans react to gaming's biggest release
events.description: Critics are calling the new "Grand Theft Auto VI" a masterpiece. In this edition of arts24, we hear what fans make of one of the biggest video game releases in history. We also look at U2's new album and tour marking 50 years of the band, discover the French comic book that Pope Leo is reading and meet the women redefining Mexico's Mariachi tradition.

events.title: The chocolate countdown: The art of the advent calendar
events.description: The holiday season is almost upon us and with it come advent calendars. The annual physical countdown originated in 19th-century Germany as a Christian tradition to count down the days until Christmas. Eugénie Pont from the magazine Fou de Pâtisserie tells us more about what we can expect from the biggest chocolate makers in France.

events.description: No description available.

events.title: Newborn dies after suspected female genital mutilation in Senegal; relatives arrested
events.description: Three people have been arrested in eastern Senegal after a newborn baby girl died following alleged female genital mutilation
events.ticker_label: 💥 Newborn dies after suspected female genital mutilation in Senegal; relatives arrested

events.title: 4 men found guilty of sex crimes against British woman in a case that recalls Gisèle Pelicot's
events.description: Four British men have been found guilty of multiple sexual crimes against a woman whose ex-husband drugged and advertised her for sex online

events.title: University lecturer from Serbia's student-led movement is elected Parliament speaker
events.description: A university lecturer from Serbia's student-led movement has become Parliament speaker

events.title: Mongolia's lawmakers accept president's resignation following corruption accusations
events.description: Mongolia’s parliament has accepted President Khurelsukh Ukhnaa's resignation after he was accused of benefiting from a government railway project seven years ago, when he served as prime minister

events.title: South Korea’s top court overturns charges against ex-PM for his role in martial law
events.description: South Korea’s Supreme Court has overturned the conviction of former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo

events.title: Funding cuts raise risks of trafficking and exploitation for refugee children
events.description: Sharp reductions in humanitarian funding are putting refugees, particularly children, at increased risk of being trafficked, exploited or abused, while the systems that protect them are weakening.

events.title: Guterres calls for a legally binding instrument for ‘killer robots'
events.description: Talks began in Geneva on Monday to push for controls on lethal autonomous weapons systems that are often referred to as “killer robots”.

events.title: MICHAEL RUIZ: Lindsay Clancy scores 'little win,' but appeal could 'unravel' future trials, retired judge says
events.description: Lindsay Clancy heads to the Supreme Judicial Court Thursday with her double jeopardy appeal before jury selection in her March retrial begins.

events.title: Florida DMV worker faces 360 felonies for allegedly helping illegal aliens get licenses without driving tests
events.description: Investigators say Lynnette Stitt Williams accepted fake utility bills and skipped driving tests to push 60 licenses through Pembroke Pines office.

events.title: Brother of slain surfing legend never lost hope as 9-month hunt rode wave of clues to Costa Rican lover
events.description: Peter Van Dyke says he never gave up hope for justice after his brother, surfer Kurt Van Dyke, was murdered in Costa Rica as his girlfriend faces arrest.

events.title: Florida pastor convicted in Haitian president's assassination plot funded partly by US COVID relief money
events.description: Christian Emmanuel Sanon was convicted in the plot to kill Haitian President Jovenel Moïse, a scheme prosecutors say was hatched in South Florida.

events.title: ‘Looksmaxxing’ influencer ‘Clavicular’ allegedly told teen to lie about age, call vodka ‘water’ before assault
events.description: Looksmaxxing influencer Braden Peters, known as "Clavicular," faces Massachusetts rape charges after a woman says he gave her alcohol when she was 17.

events.title: Students at $90K-a-year college forced to fight off dorm intruder accused of grabbing woman by the throat
events.description: Diaunte Adams allegedly followed a Northwestern University student from a train into her dorm, bypassing two layers of security before students stepped in.

events.title: Susan Smith's ex-husband wants her ‘in prison until she dies’ after killing sons in alleged bid to win lover
events.description: David Smith says he wants Susan Smith to stay in prison until she dies for killing their sons as the South Carolina parole board weighs her request.

events.title: Bukele gets hero’s welcome from afar as thousands rally in Haiti after gang crackdown
events.description: Thousands marched in Haiti to thank Nayib Bukele for sending troops to battle violent gangs, prompting an emotional response from the Salvadoran president.
